2486-4694-5231-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-4694-5231-7306.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Repeat from step 1.

277-2577-6495-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
277-2577-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
277-2577-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3121-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Master enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3680-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3680-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Stunt Double each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3680-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7933.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cold-Blooded Crew.
When Cold-Blooded Crew dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cold-Blooded Crew enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1722-1912-2034-7365-7824.description:
Activate Katara by paying {4} due to Biomancer's Familiar, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1722-1912-2034-7365-7824.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

152-7826.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
152-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {5} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

2685-3197-7743-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-3197-7743-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1274-2685-3263-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2685-3263-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2946-3967-4871-5075.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3967-4871-5075.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6556-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6556-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

2866-3689-6518-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
2866-3689-6518-7693.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3259-4478-5734.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant that doesn't have summoning sickness.
3259-4478-5734.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

423-872-1437-3756--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-872-1437-3756--85.description:
Cast Scaled Herbalist by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Scaled Herbalist spell three times.
Resolve the first Scaled Herbalist copy.
Activate the Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

774-1671-6763.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Simic Growth Chamber's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

141-4924-7301.description:
Cast Avatar's Wrath by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Heartless Summoning.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Avatar's Wrath
Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Heartless Summoning.
Repeat from step 3.

2921-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1496-2034-3490-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-2034-3490-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

3963-5361-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
3963-5361-7009.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3963-5361-7009.description:
Activate Auton Soldier using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Meneldor. Meneldor triggers, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

141-997-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-997-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-997-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

3394-4050-5544-6822.notablePrerequisites: Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
3394-4050-5544-6822.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lyla trigger.
Repeat.

5332-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5332-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

1368-3698--44.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact with mana value 0, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast the artifact from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
When the artifact enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.
1368-3698--44.notes: Depending on what artifact you choose, additional results may be added.

4067-4703-6609.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you controll
4067-4703-6609.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Brallin triggers, putting a counter on it and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

440-1339-2034-2999.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2034-2999.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-5933.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

64-4377-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons and Warden of the Eye each turn.
64-4377-6122.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Warden of the Eye by paying its mana cost.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Warden of the Eye from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

659-3480-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-3480-4381-4613.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

1469-4131-5647.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Court of Vantress triggers, creating a token copy of Basalt Monolith.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Roxanne's second ability triggers, adding {C}.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1863-3946-4572.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1643-2073-3459-3698.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters the battlefield, Battered Golem and Grinding Station trigger, untapping themselves.
Activate Clown Car's crew ability by tapping Battered Golem, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill 3 cards.
Repeat.

575-631-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Grim Haruspex, adding {B}.
When Grim Haruspex dies, Yedora triggers, returning Grim Haruspex from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Grim Haruspex by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Grim Haruspex's morph ability by paying {B}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2351-3219-4463.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a creature without flying.
2351-3219-4463.description:
During an opponent's turn, after their untap step, activate Verity Circle by paying {4}{U}, tapping target creature an opponent controls without flying.
Verity Circle triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher in the Water's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Junk Winder triggers, tapping target creature an opponent controls.
Repeat from step 2 for each remaining creature opponents control.
Repeat from step 1 after each of your turns.

1170-1306-3634.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Venser.
Venser enters the battlefield, returning Mana Crypt to your hand.
Repeat.

3-747-2232-4050.description:
Cast Sanctum of Tranquil Light by paying {W}.
Sanctum of Tranquil Light enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Go-Shintai.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Go-Shintai trigger, creating a 1/1 Shrine enchantment creature token.
The Shrine token enters the battlefield triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Sanctum of Tranquil Light from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Shrine token, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1684-2178-4050-4772.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1684-2178-4050-4772.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it to create two Elemental token with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Elemental token, adding {R}.
Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

2825-4821.notablePrerequisites: Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.Nonland permanents you control can tap for at least {3}.
2825-4821.description:
Activate the nonland permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Dramatic Reversal and casting the copy.
Resolve the Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Repeat.
